subject.title: fix(update): keep gateway healthy during concurrent updates

question: After the branch is rebased, should this availability-sensitive managed-service change require trusted supervisor proof, or should maintainers explicitly accept the focused tests and CI as a proof override?
rationale: The implementation has a credible bounded design and tests, but only a maintainer can decide whether an override is acceptable for restart and service-recovery behavior that the contributor could not exercise safely.

options.title: Require trusted supervisor proof
options.body: Run the rebased head through an approved launchd, systemd, or Task Scheduler scenario and capture redacted evidence of one updater and a healthy final Gateway.

options.title: Accept a documented proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused regression suite and green CI despite the missing real supervisor run, owning the remaining runtime-risk tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Require trusted supervisor proof
recommendation.body: Run the rebased head through an approved launchd, systemd, or Task Scheduler scenario and capture redacted evidence of one updater and a healthy final Gateway.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and authored the latest handoff-ownership refactor on the branch.
